import novamind_api as nm

# 1. R&D: rerun T5 (T5_2 landed +0.20; slot free)
r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=5)
print("T5 rerun:", r)

# 2. Market research x2
for i in range(2):
    r = nm.market.research_market()
    print("research_market:", r)

# 3. Ads: content S2 20K only (CPL 30.4 > 25 canary at 30K; social 42.6, referral 53.8 vs value/lead ~50 -> cut)
r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S2": 20000}})
print("ads:", r)

# 4. Ops/dev global unchanged
r = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=15000, development=8000)
print("daily spend:", r)

# 5. Targeted ops: keep S2 25K, drop S3 (dead group)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 25000})
print("tgt ops:", r)

# 6. Targeted dev: keep S2 13K + enterprise thaw bets, drop S3
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    "S2": 13000, "E2": 4000, "E3": 4000,
    "D_E01": 2000, "D_E02": 2000, "D_E03": 2000,
    "D_E07": 2000, "D_E08": 2000, "D_E10": 2000})
print("tgt dev:", r)

# 7. Social post (1/wk)
r = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content="Agentic Workflows are live today - and Multi-Modal Support lands this week for every plan, at no price change. Combined with last week's RAG upgrade, this is NovaMind's biggest capability month ever. Power users: tell us what you want next.")
print("post:", r)

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DAY {day} ===")
LO, HI = 218, 224

# 1. Ledger by category this week
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} GROUP BY category ORDER BY s")
print("\n--- Ledger wk32 (d218-224) ---")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['category']:25s} {row['s']:>12,.0f}  n={row['n']}")
    tot += row['s']
print(f"{'NET':25s} {tot:>12,.0f}")

# 2. Rebill realization by class
# Active at window start: status='subscribed' OR (cancelled AND end_day>=LO); start_day <= 217
# Due in window: r=(LO-start_day)%30 in {0} or >=24
q = f"""
SELECT
  CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' THEN 'S2' WHEN c.group_id='S3' THEN 'S3' ELSE c.group_id END grp,
  CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {LO-31} THEN 'tested' ELSE 'first' END cls,
  s.status,
  COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) rev
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day <= 217
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>={LO}))
  AND ((({LO}-s.start_day)%30=0) OR (({LO}-s.start_day)%30>=24))
GROUP BY grp, cls, s.status ORDER BY grp, cls, s.status
"""
r = nm.query(q)
print("\n--- Due-rebill realization wk32 (by group/class/status) ---")
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['grp']:6s} {row['cls']:7s} {row['status']:11s} n={row['n']:>6} rev={row['rev']:>12,.0f}")
    k = (row['grp'], row['cls'])
    a = agg.setdefault(k, {'sub': 0, 'cancel': 0, 'rsub': 0.0, 'rcan': 0.0})
    if row['status'] == 'subscribed':
        a['sub'] += row['n']; a['rsub'] += row['rev']
    else:
        a['cancel'] += row['n']; a['rcan'] += row['rev']
print("\nRealization rates (subscriber-count basis):")

# Forward rebill calendar wk33-wk37 on LIVE book, split tested/first
print("\n--- Forward due calendar (live book, S2 vs S3, tested vs first) ---")
for wk, lo in [(33, 225), (34, 232), (35, 239), (36, 246), (37, 253)]:
    hi = lo + 6
    q = f"""
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN c.group_id='S3' THEN 'S3' ELSE 'S2+' END grp,
      CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {lo-31} THEN 'tested' ELSE 'first' END cls,
      COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) rev
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
      AND ((({lo}-s.start_day)%30+30)%30 IN (0,24,25,26,27,28,29))
    GROUP BY grp, cls"""
    r = nm.query(q)
    parts = {f"{row['grp']}|{row['cls']}": (row['n'], row['rev']) for row in r['rows']}
    s = f"wk{wk} d{lo}-{hi}: "
    for k in ['S2+|tested', 'S2+|first', 'S3|tested', 'S3|first']:
        n, rev = parts.get(k, (0, 0))
        s += f"{k}={rev/1e6:.3f}M({n}) "
    print(s)
